sql: select e.key exp, e.state, 'v'||v.version||'/e'||ep.epoch_number ve, (ep.ended_at is null) ep_open, d.deployment_key dep, d.stage, d.kind, (d.ended_at is null) dep_open, td.deployment_key twin_of, a.arm_key, a.role, coalesce(da.strategy_tag,a.strategy_tag) tag from experiment_deployment_arms da join experiment_deployments d on d.id=da.deployment_id join experiment_arms a on a.id=da.arm_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=a.version_id join experiments e on e.id=v.experiment_id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.id=d.epoch_id left join experiment_deployments td on td.id=d.twin_of_deployment_id where e.state<>'RETIRED' and d.ended_at is null order by e.key, d.deployment_key, a.role, a.arm_key
